text:
alex: Heads up — created a tiny Next.js Edge starter that demos LlamaIndex + Redwood embeddings. users hitting a weird perf/regression: embeddings are being recomputed on every navigation, even though the index artifact exists in KV. repo: https://git.company/oss/next-edge-llama-starter
nina: repro steps? is this SSR or client-side navigation?
alex: repro with SSR -> client transition. flow: server builds index and persists snapshot to KV (namespace 'site-docs'), client calls /api/embed (edge) which should reuse the snapshot, but we see a mismatch and a full rebuild.
infra-bot: traced recent deploy 2026-03-23T18:01:12Z deploy.id=deploy-78f2 event=build.complete
alex: minimal server snippet below:
```js
// pages/api/build-index.js (Node runtime)
import { LlamaIndex } from '@redwood/inference-node'
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const idx = await LlamaIndex.buildFromDocs('site-docs', docs)
  await idx.persist() // writes to KV
  return res.json({ status: 'ok' })
}
```
and the edge embed call:
```js
// pages/api/embed.js (Edge runtime)
import { loadIndex } from '@redwood/inference-edge'
export default async function handler(req) {
  const idx = await loadIndex('site-docs')
  const vec = await idx.embed(req.body.text)
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(vec))
}
```
oscar: that smells like serialization parity — node persisted snapshot with default base64, edge loader expecting hex (or vice versa). any KV get logs?
alex: yes — KV get returns the snapshot blob, but loadIndex throws: "unrecognized snapshot format" in edge logs. snippet:
```
2026-03-23T18:02:15Z INFO kv.get site-docs/snapshot size=164k
2026-03-23T18:02:15Z ERROR llama.load IndexError: unrecognized snapshot format
```
nina: did you pin SDK versions? maybe edge uses 0.12.2 and node uses 0.13.0 with a changed serializer.
alex: good catch — package.json had a caret for @redwood/inference so local install pulled node 0.13.0 and edge runtime image uses 0.12.1 in our CI.
devx: this is a classic starter-footgun. recommendation: make the starter lockfile pin identical SDK across both runtimes and add a startup check that validates snapshot roundtrip.
oscar: small workaround: explicitly set serializer in the index persist/load API: e.g. idx.persist({ serializer: 'json.v1' }) and loadIndex('site-docs', { serializer: 'json.v1' }) so both paths use same codec.
alex: confirmed — forcing serializer to 'json.v1' fixed the repro locally. also validated that upgrading both runtimes to 0.13.0 fixes parity without explicit serializer.
nina: for DX: add a postinstall script that verifies lockfile contains identical @redwood/inference versions for node and edge builds. also add a note in README about runtime parity and upgrades.
devx: let's add a tiny eval harness test too: spawn a headless SSR build -> persist snapshot -> call edge loader -> assert load success and no rebuild (we can check trace span counts). can wire into our quickplay CI job.
oscar: also add a telemetry warning in the SDK when serializers differ across builds — emit a warn log on load that writes out detected serializer and SDK version so we can surface in troubleshooting.
alex: I'll open PR with: (1) package lock pin, (2) serializer explicit option in example, (3) postinstall validator script, (4) jest e2e for snapshot roundtrip. pinging @nina for review.
nina: thanks — also include a small checklist in the starter README for deploy targets (Vercel edge vs Node server) so users understand runtime boundaries.
alex: PR queued, labeling as medium-sev DX. will follow up with changelog entry and backport to other starters.
